winners.name: FOTM Upsell - A&P Coffee vs Latte (take-rate)
winners.outcome: WINNER = Coffee (control) on the pre-registered rev-per-impression metric, consistent across both readouts: coffee $0.1319/vis vs latte $0.1115/vis (net @20% off). Take-rate (leading indicator) coffee 0.825% vs latte 0.558% â€” nominally significant at end (z=1.97, p=0.0486) but treated CAUTIOUSLY as a second peek (was p=0.107 on 6/26 at first readout; sequential-peeking inflation). 18 days, both gates met (~3.3x sample target), SRM clean (7394 vs 7531, p=0.262). PRACTICAL DISPOSITION: coffee is already the live default, so control retained â€” NO product rollout needed. The latte $24.99 price premium does NOT rescue its lower take. Sitewide guardrail (latte CR 5.52% vs coffee 4.83%) contradicts take-rate as pre-registered to ignore (primary-dominated, noisy). Theme cleanup dispatched to ThemeSmith (turn enable_ab_test OFF; modal falls back to coffee default = desired permanent state). Pivot effort to Round-2 relevance/category-match test.
